subject: Logic
title: Optionality
description: A fast breakdown of Optionality for builders.

hook.text: A friend turns down a stable job to freelance. Risky? Maybe—but freelancing keeps ten doors open instead of one.

buildup.text: Optionality is the value of having multiple future paths available without being locked into one.

discovery.text: Options have asymmetric payoffs: limited downside but potentially unlimited upside. That asymmetry is gold.

twist.text: Traditional planning picks one optimal path. Optionality-thinking keeps cheap options alive as long as possible.

climax.text: Under deep uncertainty, maximize the number of future choices rather than optimizing today's single best choice.

quiz.question: What is optionality?
options: The value of keeping multiple future paths available
